items.headline: Els Urges Woods to Join Champions
items.text: Ernie Els encourages Tiger Woods to start competing on the PGA Tour Champions in 2027, highlighting health benefits and more relaxed rules.

items.headline: Woods Still Golf’s Biggest Star
items.text: Tiger Woods remains the biggest star in golf despite not competing since July 2024, with critiques noting he missed a chance to make a blockbuster offer to Bryson DeChambeau.
